March 16, 2026

REVENUE DELEGATION AUTHORITY ORDER NO. 0 4 i ~ 2 0 2 6

In view of the official travel of MARISSA O. CABREROS, Deputy Commissioner for
Strategic Reforms Group, to attend the 2026 PEMNA High-Level Plenary Conference in
Seoul, South Korea on March 31 — April 2, 2026 (exclusive of travel time), and in order not to
disrupt the operations of this Bureau, as the exigencies of the service so requiring, documents
requiring review and initials as provided in Revenue Delegation Authority Order No. 84-2025
shall be processed by their respective Assistant Commissioners prior to transmittal to the
Office of the Commissioner.

This order shall take effect on March 30, 2026, and shall be automatically revoked
upon the return of Deputy Commissioner Marissa O. Cabreros for official duty.

CHARLITO MARTIN R. CNET

Commissioner of Internal Revenue
